title: Almighty God, Thy Word Is Cast
description: Almighty God, Thy Word Is Cast in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Cawood wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 13.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Al-might-y God, Thy Word is cast Like seed in-to the ground; Now let the dew of heaven de-scend And right-eous fruits a-bound.

lines: Almighty God, Thy Word is cast
Now let the dew of heaven descend
Let not the foe of Christ and man
But give it root in every heart
To bring forth fruits of love.
Let not the world’s deceitful cares
But let it yield a hundredfold
The fruits of peace and joy.
Oft as the precious seed is sown,
That all whose souls the truth receive

licence: Public domain: John Cawood died in 1852.
credits: Words by John Cawood (1775–1852), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
